description: This Java class `CacheFactory` provides static factory methods for creating cache instances and related utility objects within the Eclipse Ditto framework. It handles cache configuration, creation of cache lookup contexts, and entity ID generation. The class is designed to facilitate flexible cache instantiation with configurable expiration policies and optional cache loaders.

classes.name: CacheFactory
classes.description: A utility class providing factory methods for creating cache instances and related objects based on configuration.

methods.name: newEntityId
methods.description: Creates a new EntityId with a specified resource type and EntityId.

methods.name: newCacheLookupContext
methods.description: Creates a new cache lookup context with optional DittoHeaders and JsonFieldSelector.

methods.name: createCache
methods.description: Creates a cache with specified configuration and executor; optionally with a cache loader.

methods.name: caffeine
methods.description: Configures a Caffeine builder instance based on cache configuration and executor, setting expiration policies.
